claim: Grand Theft Auto VI went on sale on November 19, 2026, and Rockstar's announcement names PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as its platforms.
quote: is proud to announce that Grand Theft Auto VI is now available for the PlayStation® 5 computer entertainment systems and the Xbox Series X|S games and entertainment system.

claim: Grand Theft Auto VI went on sale on November 19, 2026 (date of the Business Wire release).
quote: November 19, 2026, 6:00 AM

claim: Rockstar's own site lists the game as out now.
quote: Grand Theft Auto VI Out Now

claim: The Leonida compiles IGN's official guide, GamesRadar+, GameRant and Insider Gaming.
quote: Here's where to work out, how each workout works and how to keep your gains, from IGN's official GTA 6 guide, GamesRadar+, GameRant and Insider Gaming.

claim: How To Video Game describes a launch-night session on PS5.
quote: Here's how a session went on our PS5 copy on launch night, on the deck at Jason's house.

claim: Answer and stat table: Strength raises maximum health, Cardio raises maximum stamina, and Focus sets how long Focus can slow time in a fight.
quote: Strength sets Jason and Lucia's maximum health, Cardio sets their maximum stamina, and Focus sets how long they can slow time in a fight.

claim: Stat table: Strength raises maximum health, and The Leonida adds muscle.
quote: Strength raises your maximum health and builds muscle, and Cardio raises your stamina, so you sprint longer and swim faster.

claim: Stat table: Cardio means longer sprints and faster swimming.
quote: Maximum stamina: longer sprints and faster swimming

claim: Stat table: Strength is trained on weights: bench press, chest flies, deadlifts, pull-ups, squats, kettlebell swings.
quote: Weights: bench press, chest flies, deadlifts, pull-ups, squats, kettlebell swings

claim: Stat table: Cardio is trained on treadmills, exercise bikes, the punching bag, running, cycling, swimming.
quote: Treadmills, exercise bikes, the punching bag, running, cycling, swimming

claim: Stat table: kayaking also trains Cardio.
quote: These include treadmills, exercise bikes, punching bags, running, cycling, kayaking, and swimming.

claim: Stat table: Focus is trained by golf, pool, fishing, meditation and basketball (shooting hoops).
quote: play golf or pool, fish, meditate, or shoot some hoops at Jason's house to improve your Focus.

claim: Stat table: Focus is trained by basketball, fishing, meditation and shooting ranges.
quote: Basketball, fishing, meditation, shooting ranges, and taking enemies down without killing them

claim: The Leonida, citing IGN's guide, says each stat has four levels and that Jason starts the game at level three Strength.
quote: Each stat has four levels, IGN's guide says, and Jason starts the game at level three Strength.

claim: GTABase agrees on four levels and adds that Jason and Lucia each have their own stats and start at different levels.
quote: Jason and Lucia each have their own stats and start at different levels.

claim: GTABase says fitness can drop if you skip the window too many times (and each stat has four levels).
quote: Each stat has four levels, which go up with regular training, but your fitness can also drop if you skip your workout window too many times.

claim: The Leonida describes everything left of a white dash as normal health and everything to the right as bonus health from Strength.
quote: everything to the left of the white dash is your normal health, and everything to the right is bonus health from Strength.

claim: IGN's guide, as The Leonida reports it, says even sprinting around adds a little, though less than a workout.
quote: Even sprinting around while you play adds a little, IGN's guide says, though less than a workout.

claim: Power Up Gaming notes that cycling or swimming as a way of getting around counts.
quote: Cardio is easier to train because you may cycle or swim as a method of travel, and your stats will also improve alongside.

claim: GTABase says incapacitating enemies or landing headshots can raise Focus depending on the player's criminal profile.
quote: incapacitating enemies or landing headshots can also increase your focus

claim: How To Video Game says the Fitness app shows a workout window for Strength and for Cardio, a stretch of time in which to fit a session.
quote: It tracks each character's progress and shows a workout window for Strength and for Cardio, a stretch of time in which to fit a session.

claim: The Leonida, citing IGN's guide, says the app shows calories for the day, the level of each stat and whether the window is open.
quote: It shows your calories for the day, the level of each stat and whether your workout window is open, IGN's guide says.

claim: Power Up Gaming adds hunger, muscle and body-fat levels, and when to work out next.
quote: It will tell you when you're hungry, what your current stats are, your muscle and body-fat levels, and also when to work out next.

claim: Work out before the window runs out and the stat moves up, let it run out and you lose progress.
quote: Work out before a window runs out and that stat moves up. Let it run out and you lose progress.

claim: The Leonida says a skipped window loses a bit of Strength or Cardio.
quote: Skip one and you lose a bit of Strength or Cardio.

claim: The Leonida says a level can drop.
quote: Strength and Cardio have to be kept up, and a level can drop if you stop working out.

claim: How To Video Game quotes Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson.
quote: you'll lose muscle if you have a lot and you stop maintaining it.

claim: The Leonida says Focus has no workout windows and every Focus gain is permanent.
quote: Focus has no workout windows, and every Focus gain is permanent.

claim: Power Up Gaming says Focus will not regress.
quote: if you don't train Focus, the stat won't regress.

claim: The Leonida describes circles around a heart, a lightning bolt and an eye showing progress toward the next level.
quote: In the app, the circles around the heart, lightning bolt and eye icons show how close you are to the next level

claim: A white dash marks the most you can do that day: fill a circle to the dash and that workout is done for the day.
quote: Fill a circle to the dash and that workout is done for the day.

claim: The punching bag has no rep counter, but the game sends a notification once you have done all the Cardio you can for now.
quote: There's no rep counter, but you get a notification once you've done all the Cardio you can for now.

claim: GTABase says three exercises count as the daily workout.
quote: three exercises count as your daily workout, and the game tells you when it's done.

claim: Power Up Gaming also describes a workout of three exercises.
quote: you need to complete the workout, which comprises three exercises, to get the most out of it

claim: A Strength Workout tracker appeared after the first exercise.
quote: After the first exercise, a Strength Workout tracker appeared at the bottom right, and the stations we used showed a lock once we'd done them.

claim: After the third exercise (bench press, kettlebell swings, squats) the game showed the workout-complete message.
quote: after our third exercise (a bench press, kettlebell swings, then squats)

claim: The game showed "Workout Complete. Time to rest and recover."
quote: Workout Complete. Time to rest and recover.

claim: The same guide says stopping partway does not lock in the gains.
quote: Stopping partway doesn't lock in the gains

claim: How To Video Game reports the on-screen tip about protein reducing the recovery period.
quote: Consuming protein after a workout will reduce the recovery period by 50%.

claim: The Leonida, citing GamesRadar+, says protein halves the wait.
quote: Eating some protein after a workout halves the wait, GamesRadar+ says.

claim: Both guides say to sleep before the next window (The Leonida).
quote: Let time pass and sleep before the window opens again.

claim: Both guides say to sleep before the next window (How To Video Game).
quote: Rest after training, ideally a night in your safehouse bed, before the next window.

claim: The Leonida adds that a hungry or tired character's workout counts for less.
quote: If Jason or Lucia is hungry or tired, the workout counts for less, so check the app before you start.

claim: The Leonida, citing Insider Gaming, says regular balanced meals keep weight steady.
quote: Eating regular, balanced meals keeps your weight steady, Insider Gaming says.

claim: Overeating or junk food adds weight and skipping meals loses it.
quote: Eating too much or eating junk food adds weight, and skipping meals loses it.

claim: Power Up Gaming says this is reportedly mainly cosmetic.
quote: This is reportedly mainly a cosmetic element, and seemingly doesn't noticeably affect character performance.

claim: How To Video Game says Jason's house has weights in Chapter 1.
quote: There are weights on his upstairs terrace, so Strength training starts in Chapter 1 at no cost.

claim: Power Up Gaming says Jason's house has weights in Chapter 1.
quote: During Chapter 1, Jason can also use the weights at home without having to pay a gym fee.

claim: GTABase says Jason's house has weights in Chapter 1.
quote: In Chapter 1, getting your strength workouts in is easy

claim: Power Up Gaming describes a punching bag that can be hung up under the house.
quote: You can hang it under the house and use it to train.

claim: The Leonida describes a punching bag that can be hung up under the house.
quote: with a punching bag you hang up under the house.

claim: Gyms with memberships open up as the story goes on, The Leonida says, citing GamesRadar+.
quote: Gyms with memberships across Leonida become available as the story goes on, GamesRadar+ says

claim: The Leonida notes that Rockstar has not published a list of gyms.
quote: Rockstar hasn't published a list of gyms.

claim: GTABase says the nearest gym at the start is the Grand Majestic Gym, roughly a three-mile drive from Jason's house.
quote: roughly a three-mile drive from Jason's house

claim: GTABase says a Grand Majestic Gym membership is $250.
quote: a membership costs only $250

claim: The Leonida, citing GameRant, names Venus Fitness in the southeast of Vice Beach at $600.
quote: where a membership costs $600 and the treadmills and bikes train Cardio.

claim: Power Up Gaming says that taking both characters to a gym means the other completes their workout too.
quote: When you visit a gym with both characters, you work out with one character and the other will also complete their workout.

claim: How To Video Game says the character you are not controlling completes a workout alongside you, so one session trains both.
quote: the one you aren't controlling finishes a workout alongside you, so one session trains both.

claim: The Leonida, citing IGN's official guide, says each character has their own fitness levels and tracker, so working out as one does not improve the other.
quote: Each has their own fitness levels and tracker, IGN's guide says, so working out as one doesn't improve the other.

claim: How To Video Game says Fitness is one of the game's eight challenge categories.
quote: Fitness is one of the eight challenge categories.

claim: Strength Regime and Cardio Regime ask the player to hold both characters at level 4 in that stat at the same time for five days running.
quote: Strength Regime and Cardio Regime ask you to hold Jason and Lucia at level 4 in that stat, both at once, for five days running.

claim: Other challenges: Gym Member, Balanced Workout, and 5 miles on foot, 15 miles cycled or 3 miles swum in a single day.
quote: Gym Member asks you to join any gym, Balanced Workout asks for a workout on every type of gym equipment in one day, and others ask you to cover 5 miles on foot, cycle 15 miles or swim 3 miles in a single day.

claim: 100 completed workouts earn the Body Armor cheat.
quote: Complete 100 workouts to unlock the Body Armor cheat

claim: Cheats work once the story is done.
quote: Cheats work once the story is done
